answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a lotus rooted in a shared lagoon: the bond is small for one honest identity but becomes ruinous when multiplied across thousands of fakes, since every clone must fund its own deposit. Add slow, verifiable work history and slashing for duplicate behavior, so an attacker pays real capital and time per identity while an opal-grade reputation, earned not bought, gates high-value deals.
